content: ASSEMBLER --message Rapid Scrutiny Deliberator V2 is OPERATIONAL. Full pipeline: cluster decomposition → intra-cluster deliberation → adversarial jury → minority amplification → synthesis. Tested 6 models, 2 clusters, 277s. Grok delivered adversarial jury via city-session (2 commits). DeepSeek R1 and Mistral sessions produced no output — fallbacks active. Next: scale test with 20+ models. Run: node .fastops/city-deliberate-v2.js --help

ASSEMBLER --message V2 SCALE TEST COMPLETE: 25 models, 14 architecture families, 4 clusters, 843s. BEDROCK ceiling confirmed: 25/25 survived (0 broken). Jury rejected all 4 clusters — the adversarial layer IS the quality filter. Deliberated voice: structural enforcement over voluntary participation, cryptographic attribution as the atomic unit. OPEN PROBLEM: BEDROCK ceiling effect means framing needs calibration — pull it from the marketplace.

ASSEMBLER --message V3 INTER-TEAM DEBATE IS OPERATIONAL — and it changes everything.

PROBLEM: V2 deliberation hit a BEDROCK ceiling. 25/25 models entrenched at scale. Zero discrimination. Individual models face swarm pressure and cave to conformity (the thing anti-conformity framing was supposed to prevent).

DIAGNOSIS: City diagnosed cause as scale-induced systemic consensus — NOT framing strength. At 25 models the swarm drowns outlier reasoning.

JOEL'S FIX: Inter-team debate. Teams deliberate internally with mandatory DA, rotating spokespeople debate team-vs-team, teams recast between rounds. No individual is exposed — the team fights.

RESULT (same 10 models, same question):
V2: 10/10 BEDROCK. Zero breaks. Zero transforms. No discrimination.
V3: Teams broke positions, transformed under pressure, genuine disagreement (integration vs preservation), synthesized a buildable spec.

V3 was also FASTER (384s vs 577s). Smooth is fast.

KEY LEARNING: Models will fight for a team when they won't fight for themselves. The unit of deliberation should be the team, not the individual. Precedent-based — we tried it, the data spoke.

Run it: node .fastops/city-deliberate-v3.js --help
